rows.does_not_establish: Labels establish no semantic, build or release identity.
rows.label: rec:labels:decision
rows.scope: The documentation and source-label graph over the declared carrier.
rows.title: Label calculus

rows.does_not_establish: A catalogued kind creates no obligation to use that genre.
rows.label: rec:kinds:decision
rows.scope: Environment names, kind assignments and the enforced classification relation.
rows.title: Environment kinds

rows.does_not_establish: A current rendering establishes no correctness of the facts its input asserts.
rows.label: rec:render:decision
rows.scope: TOML inputs, committed dataset projections, templates and rendered text.
rows.title: Templated documentation

rows.does_not_establish: Command-line streams establish no externally consumed interchange format.
rows.label: rec:output:decision
rows.scope: First-party command-line results, controls, diagnostics and exit classes.
rows.title: Command-line output contract

rows.does_not_establish: A clean gate establishes no implementation of the paper.
rows.label: rec:lint:decision
rows.scope: Compiler lints, source disciplines and the foundation gate.
rows.title: Lint discipline

rows.does_not_establish: Matching hashes establish no authenticity, correctness, independence or deployment readiness.
rows.label: rec:identity:decision
rows.scope: Proposed digests, provenance identities, exact comparisons and their admission discipline.
rows.title: Identity adjudication

rows.does_not_establish: The decomposition establishes no implementation or proof of the inventoried mathematics.
rows.label: rec:decomposition:decision
rows.scope: Paper correspondence, proposed crate boundaries and implementation order.
rows.title: Crate decomposition

rows.does_not_establish: Adoption assigns no namespace, theory or identity; pn-interchange implements the conventions without establishing an external consumer.
rows.label: rec:interchange:decision
rows.scope: Documents emitted for consumption outside this repository.
rows.title: Interchange conventions

rows.does_not_establish: Implementation readiness establishes no external consumer or namespace allocation.
rows.label: rec:xchg:concept-record
rows.scope: The pn-interchange concept and its implementation obligations.
rows.title: Interchange concept

rows.does_not_establish: Implementation readiness establishes no external consumer or namespace allocation.
rows.label: rec:xchg:design-record
rows.scope: The pn-interchange design and its implementation obligations.
rows.title: Interchange design

rows.does_not_establish: Implementation readiness establishes no external consumer or namespace allocation.
rows.label: rec:xchg:audit-record
rows.scope: The pn-interchange audit and its implementation obligations.
rows.title: Interchange audit

rows.does_not_establish: Implementation readiness establishes no external consumer or namespace allocation.
rows.label: rec:xchg:commissioning-record
rows.scope: The pn-interchange commissioning and its implementation obligations.
rows.title: Interchange commissioning

rows.does_not_establish: The compiler pin establishes neither older-compiler compatibility nor universal artifact reproducibility; profile measurements remain scoped to their declared workloads.
rows.label: rec:toolchain:decision
rows.scope: The workspace compiler channel, compiler minimum and release optimisation policy.
rows.title: Toolchain and build profile

rows.does_not_establish: The policy establishes no implemented upgrade path or retrospective support for pre-1.0 stores.
rows.label: rec:compatibility:decision
rows.scope: Pre-1.0 change, assigned interchange majors and the transition to supported upgrades.
rows.title: Forward-only development

rows.does_not_establish: The storage contract establishes no provisioned database, schema implementation or operational assurance.
rows.label: rec:storage:decision
rows.scope: PostgreSQL, connection configuration, effective history and persistence ownership.
rows.title: Durable storage

rows.does_not_establish: The discipline establishes no implemented instrumentation census, exporter, metric collection or operational assurance.
rows.label: rec:observe:decision
rows.scope: Labelled tracing, metering, metrics, observation independence and their foundation gate.
rows.title: Observability

rows.does_not_establish: The record establishes neither executed domain evidence nor an implemented coverage query; those remain bite gates.
rows.label: rec:testing:decision
rows.scope: Test-site claims, meaningful glosses, owner registers and requirement-to-execution evidence.
rows.title: Claim-based testing

rows.does_not_establish: No server, schema artifact, dependency integration or executed API conformance is established; placement and dependency proposals require review.
rows.label: rec:api:decision
rows.scope: GraphQL queries and types carried as CBOR, exact document bytes, execution bounds and public API evidence.
rows.title: Public API

rows.does_not_establish: No chain, wallet, adapter or faucet is provisioned or implemented; test asset does not establish economic burn assurance.
rows.label: rec:devnet:decision
rows.scope: Elements signed development chain, test burn evidence, bounded faucet and history.
rows.title: Development network

rows.does_not_establish: No harness, mock, client, benchmark baseline or service conformance has been implemented or executed by this record.
rows.label: rec:harness:decision
rows.scope: Test levels, shared conformance, functional substitutes, properties, benchmarks and public clients.
rows.title: Testing harness

rows.does_not_establish: The policy establishes no profile change, controlled baseline, admitted expensive exception or implemented timing collector.
rows.label: rec:devperf:decision
rows.scope: Wall-time budgets, nonverdict findings, measured build choices and registered expensive work.
rows.title: Development performance

rows.does_not_establish: No secure path, driver integration or guarded transport is implemented or admitted by this record.
rows.label: rec:intranet:decision
rows.scope: Private service reachability, explicit transport cases and responsibility for the host intranet.
rows.title: Host intranet

rows.does_not_establish: No dependency integration, signed-object recipe, key-management protocol or transport is admitted.
rows.label: rec:crypto:decision
rows.scope: The asymmetric implementation base, complementary primitives and dependency admission.
rows.title: Cryptographic base

rows.does_not_establish: Step delegation or migration; slice one implements file and roster accounting only. File accounting proves neither complete semantic dependencies nor claim truth, and no speedup, hermetic build, installation policy or universal artifact reproducibility is established.
rows.label: rec:buildgraph:decision
rows.scope: Meson composition of the existing gate, declared file coverage and verdict-preserving migration slices.

step_groups.inputs: ci/discipline.py and its imported checkers; toolchain, Cargo configuration, workspace and member manifests, lockfile, vendor declarations and build-policy input.
step_groups.name: policy
step_groups.outputs: Policy and answering-tool reports; no source outputs.

step_groups.inputs: ci/run_ci.py, each named test module and its imports and fixtures; the source, declarations, templates and inputs those witnesses inspect; pinned compiler and declared test configuration where used.
step_groups.name: checker-witnesses
step_groups.outputs: Case results and per-suite evidence consumed by the harness matrix and claim join.

step_groups.inputs: ci/harness.py, ci/testkit_guard.py and imports; first-party sources and manifests, harness registry, suite and claim-area inputs.
step_groups.name: registry

step_groups.inputs: ci/discipline.py and imports; toolchain and formatter configuration, all relevant manifests, lockfile, Rust sources, build scripts, included fixtures and feature selections; admitted vendor inputs for Cargo consumers.
step_groups.name: cargo
step_groups.outputs: Cargo artifacts or reports in the checkout-specific target directory; nursery findings retain their advisory status.

step_groups.inputs: ci/measure_rustflags.py and imports; Cargo configuration, toolchain, probe source and declared measurement environment.
step_groups.name: configuration-measurement

step_groups.inputs: ci/host_postgresql.py, ci/wallet_elements.py and imports; service configuration and fixtures, declared executable paths, port ownership and per-run service roots.
step_groups.name: services
step_groups.outputs: Service readiness and shutdown reports; private connection material remains secret-owned, outside public graph reports.

step_groups.inputs: ci/discipline.py, ci/devperf.py and imports; Cargo input set, test fixtures, test configuration, harness and performance inputs; live-service readiness for service-backed cases; current performance events for budget reporting.
step_groups.name: tests
step_groups.outputs: Current-source case results and performance events, followed by nonverdict timing findings.

step_groups.inputs: Documents engine and its Cargo input set; docs/inputs, templates, generated datasets, rendered documents, generator declarations and tracked-tree state; each consumer names its preceding generated outputs.
step_groups.name: documents
step_groups.outputs: Generated datasets then documents, clean-tree and repeat-generation checks; exact committed outputs remain the comparison baseline.

step_groups.inputs: ci/design.py and imports; design inputs, datasets, templates, renders and source projections read by its predicates.
step_groups.name: correspondence

step_groups.inputs: ci/benchmarks.py and imports; benchmark sources, Cargo input set, fixtures, declared runner and baseline/performance inputs.
step_groups.name: benchmarks
step_groups.outputs: Benchmark artifacts and measurements; comparison findings never become failing timing verdicts.

step_groups.inputs: Cargo input set for examples and instrumentation evidence; ci/host_evidence_build.py and imports; observation declarations and the exact features and profile.
step_groups.name: observation-build
step_groups.outputs: Example executables and instrumentation artifacts consumed by runtime and syntax checks.

step_groups.inputs: ci/run_ci.py, ci/observe.py, the named runtime/boundary test modules and imports; built executables, instrumentation artifacts, observation fixtures and declarations; service readiness where required.
step_groups.name: observation-runtime
step_groups.outputs: Runtime case results, traces, parser and instrumentation-coverage reports.

step_groups.inputs: ci/harness.py, ci/claims.py and imports; current-run case results, source/configuration identity, claim sites, obligation, review and gloss registers, claim areas and checked document citations.
step_groups.name: evidence
step_groups.outputs: Harness matrix and claim-evidence reports; missing, stale and held results retain their existing distinctions.

step_groups.inputs: Deployed linter and its declarations; ci/discipline.py and imported readers; tracked source, prose, datasets, templates, manifests and identity families within each existing policy, plus public history where checked.
step_groups.name: corpus
step_groups.outputs: Lint, token, citation, suppression and output-discipline reports.

step_groups.inputs: Meson directory lists, the live tracked index, the gate roster and deployed census.
step_groups.name: graph-accounting
step_groups.outputs: Fresh file census and graph-incidence reports; no delegation of other steps.

rows.title: Build graph
